meta.name: brief
meta.description: /cs:brief <topic> — Generate a one-page strategy brief from an office-hours intake. First step in the strategic sprint pipeline. Use when a strategic question needs to be framed before boardroom deliberation — e.g. locking options, assumptions, and success criteria for a pricing change or a market-entry decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把战略问题转化为一页简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在高层讨论前快速框定战略选项与成功标准
copy.tagline_en: Turn strategic questions into a one-page brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to frame strategic options and success criteria before boardroom deliberation

howto.what: 将原始问题或办公时间产出转化为一页战略简报，包含背景、问题、选项、假设、约束、成功与终止标准，并保存为Markdown文件。
howto.when: 当需要为董事会讨论框定战略问题（如定价变更或市场进入决策）时，使用 /cs:brief <topic> 或 /cs:brief <办公时间产出> 触发。

say.text: 请为我们的定价变更生成一份战略简报。
say.note: 将生成包含选项、假设等的一页简报。

say.text: 使用办公时间产出生成简报。
say.note: 解析6个答案并生成更严谨的简报。

howto.what_en: Transforms a raw question or office-hours output into a one-page strategy brief with context, question, options, assumptions, constraints, success and kill criteria, saved as a Markdown file.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /cs:brief <topic> or /cs:brief <office-hours-output> when a strategic question needs framing for boardroom deliberation, e.g., pricing change or market-entry decision.

say_en.text: Generate a strategy brief for our pricing change.
say_en.note: Produces a one-page brief with options, assumptions, etc.

say_en.text: Use the office-hours output to create a brief.
say_en.note: Parses the 6 answers for a more rigorous brief.
